UA news and information

System News

  • University-wide gift card process update

    November 20, 2026

    The gift card process improvement project has finished gathering stakeholder feedback. The project team is now drafting a request for information to find a centralized rewards management platform, with an update coming in December.

  • UA employees take part in National Compliance Week activities

    November 20, 2026

    University of Alaska employees marked National Compliance Week with activities focused on practical decisions, useful resources, and the shared responsibility to ask questions and raise concerns.

  • University of Alaska Regents praise systemwide engagement, pass budgets, tuition changes at November meeting

    November 20, 2026

    The UA Board of Regents approved FY28 budgets and strategies to increase enrollment and student success during its November 4-6 meeting in Fairbanks. The meeting resulted in substantive steps forward to improve tuition transparency, invest in workforce development and address AI's impact across the system.

More News
Did You Know?

  • Strength Through Knowledge: The people behind ANSI's first five years

    November 12, 2026

    The University of Alaska's first Alaska Native Success Initiative (ANSI) strategic plan is coming to a close. The 2026 ANSI Report shares what that plan has been building over the past five years at UAA, UAF and UAS and who has been doing the work behind the scenes.

  • Did you know UAA engineers and computer scientists are using AI to decode brain signals?

    October 01, 2026

    A new EEG headset in UAA's AI and Robotics Lab lets researchers collect their own brain activity data and use AI to interpret it.

  • Did you know a Faculty Initiative Fund grant helped create a new international learning opportunity for rural Alaska health students?

    September 11, 2026

    A two-week immersion in Peru gave future healthcare providers opportunities to explore rural healthcare challenges through a different cultural lens, while simultaneously supporting workforce development in Alaska.

More Stories
UA in the News

  • Tuition policy, AI usage discussed at UA Board of Regents meeting

    November 6 2026

    The University of Alaska Board of Regents held a series of meetings at the Butrovich Building on the Troth Yeddha’ campus in Fairbanks this week discussing a variety of topics,

    Read Regent article

  • Murkowski: University plays important role in Alaska's economic future

    November 8, 2026

    Sen. Lisa Murkowski told the University of Alaska Board of Regents she will continue to support federal funding for basic research, long term observations, the infrastructure that underpin the university’s expertise.

    Read Murkowski article

  • UAF to receive $1 million in first Department of Energy funding for critical minerals workforce

    November 5, 2026

     UAF is set to receive $1 million from the U.S. Department of Energy to build a workforce for the critical minerals industry..

    Read Critical Minerals article

Many Traditions One Alaska

The University of Alaska is a land-, sea- and space-grant system of higher education established in 1917.

The UA system's three universities (UAA, UAF and UAS) are separately accredited institutions with campuses and extended learning centers across the state of Alaska.

Learn More about the UA System
